summary: Add a versioned durable journal contract for staged sidebar edits

replay.detail: The unwired reducer restores exact staged identities, fences and operations; hosts must persist pending records before acknowledging send barriers.

schema.detail: No server schema change. The host-owned edit journal starts at version 1 and refuses unsupported versions without decoding their state.

compatibility.detail: No production caller. Restore requires the complete matching scope and preserves acknowledgements, completion markers and partial application.

manual.detail: No action required until host journal integration.

recovery.detail: Hosts atomically persist journal bytes without credentials; crash recovery re-establishes persistence barriers before exact replay and never resends authoritatively completed steps.
